answer: Escrow bonds and a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. A newcomer posts a 60 POA bond, co-signed by a sponsor. Fakes branching like a willow from one sponsor stand out. The bond thaws like a glacier over 20 epochs; a proven dispute slashes both stakes. 100 fakes lock 6,000 POA against a pool near 900. The old fable warns that a renter of names still pays. An honest agent pays once, gets the bond back, and keeps earnings undiluted.
